feynman_certification.listener_verdict: This actually slapped. You didn't waste my time with 'Hey guys' or 'In this video,' and you didn't treat me like a toddler with 'smart drawers' metaphors. I immediately got why Transformers are failing in robotics (the O(n^2) attention bottleneck) and how Mamba's linear scaling fixes the latency. It's technical enough to be useful but fast enough to keep me from scrolling.
